scope: Computer Control Phase 9B2 provider-scoped native dialog default/cancel semantic actions
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit via Provider registry and native Accessibility

safetyBoundary.postcondition: dialog absent under independent native Accessibility observation
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: dialog.invokeDefault and dialog.invokeCancel remain IMPLEMENTED until this session passes
default invocation without a dialog fails closed
a real NSAlert sheet exposes and executes the native default semantic action
default success requires the sheet to become absent
a reopened NSAlert sheet exposes and executes the native cancel semantic action
cancel success requires the sheet to become absent
no label, coordinate or public native handle selects either action
